title: Understanding Selection Bias
text: Selection bias occurs when the sample collected is not representative of the population. Think about how increasing the sample size and sending reminders might affect the representativeness of the sample.

title: Impact of Sample Size
text: Increasing the sample size from $$100$$ to $$200$$ can help reduce variability in the sample. Consider how this might influence the selection bias.

title: Effect of Reminder Emails
text: Sending reminder emails can increase the response rate. Think about how a higher response rate might affect the selection bias.

title: Comparing Bias Levels
